summary: Disa Records is a privately owned record label located in San Nicolas de los Garza, Nuevo León, Mexico. The label specializes in Spanish-language recordings. Its works are distributed in the United States by Universal Music Group.
one_line: Disa Records is a privately owned Mexican record label specializing in Spanish-language music, distributed in the US by Universal Music Group.
key_facts: Disa Records is a privately owned record label.
Disa Records is based in San Nicolas de los Garza, Nuevo León, Mexico.
Disa Records specializes in Spanish language recordings.
The works of Disa Records are distributed in the United States by Universal Music Group.
